text.enter: Jezero has begun to meet as one. Its people know one another now, and evenings end with everyone in one room, talking at once, and now and then agreeing.
text.enter_again: The colony meets as one again. Old friends have found each other, and old arguments are taken up where they were left.
text.split: The meetings have gone quiet. Friends keep to their own circles, and no one speaks for the whole colony.
text.quiet: The council meets, but no one has spoken for anything yet.
text.quiet_hard: The council meets, but the talk is all of {clause}.
text.circles: People keep to their own circles. No one yet speaks for the whole colony.
text.circles_again: The evenings are still quiet. Friends keep to their own circles, and no one gathers the whole colony.
text.circles_few: Jezero is still more a household than a colony. There are too few grown hands for a council.

text.proposal: {a} spoke of a dome at the meeting {place}: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
text.proposal_again: {a} raised the dome again at the meeting {place}.
text.divided: The council is divided over the dome. {a} speaks for building it, {ra}; {b} says not yet, {rb}.
text.set_aside: The council has set the dome aside for now. {b} spoke for waiting, and many agreed.
text.set_aside_hard: The council has set the dome aside. While {clause} runs short, no one has the heart for it.
text.set_aside_long: The talk of a dome has gone round and round. The council lets it rest for now.
text.pledge: The council has agreed to build a dome. {a} spoke for it first, and tonight, {place}, Jezero promised to build it together, {why}.
text.pledge_divided: The council has agreed to build a dome. {a} spoke for it first, and tonight, {place}, Jezero promised to build it together, {why}, though not everyone is glad of it.
text.pledge_why_personal: because its bolder hearts would not wait
text.aftermath_round: {b}, who said not yet, has come round to the dome.
text.aftermath_still: {b} still says not yet, but will build with the rest.
text.after_pledge: The council still meets most evenings. With the dome agreed, the talk is of smaller things.

yes.means: since there is stone in store
